Why NHE

  • Trench to finish, one crew

    Underground work usually means two contractors and a scheduling fight. Ours is in-house — we dig the trench, lay the duct bank, bed it and backfill clean, ready for the next trade.

  • One company, one schedule

    Excavation, demolition and grading under one roof — with our electrical division launching soon. Homeowners, GCs and builders deal with one company and one schedule.

  • Clean, tidy sites

    Grades true, trenches backfilled and compacted right, sites left tidy. The next crew on site will thank you.

  • On call when it counts

    Site problems don't keep business hours. For urgent excavation work, call (905) 993-0412 any time.

Northern Heavy & Electrical Inc. is owned and operated by Shane Thompson out of Niagara Falls, Ontario. NHE Excavation runs its own machines and operators across Southern Ontario — and the NHE Electrical division is launching soon under the same roof.

Backing Our Own

NHE is a proud jersey partner of the Niagara Falls Canucks U9 MD1 — home and away. Local support, lasting impact.
